headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.5.27-modder.83
summary: Fixed BP-heavy map stutter: disabled ForceDark/SurfaceSyncer conflict and dropped high-power WifiLock.

items.text: Fixed periodic frame stutter on behavior-pack-heavy worlds: disabled ForceDark surface sync conflict and removed high-performance WifiLock that caused MIUI/Android scheduling stalls.
